answers.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN period='H1' THEN amount_million ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN period='Q2' THEN amount_million ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) AS value FROM expenses WHERE entity='Tesla' AND metric='R&D' AND year=2024;

WITH q1 AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN period='H1' THEN amount_million ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN period='Q2' THEN amount_million ELSE 0 END) AS q1 FROM expenses WHERE entity='Tesla' AND metric='R&D' AND year=2024), q2 AS (SELECT amount_million AS q2 FROM expenses WHERE entity='Tesla' AND period='Q2' AND metric='R&D' AND year=2024) SELECT (q2 - q1) * 100.0 / q1 AS value FROM q1, q2;
